VERDICT: FAIL

The evidence is insufficient to verify criterion (1). The CI log shows 23 tests pass, but there's no evidence that any of those tests actually cover the double-charge edge case being fixed. Without seeing the code diff (the "small guard") and a specific test that reproduces and verifies the double-charge scenario, passing tests could simply mean the bug fix isn't actually exercised. Criterion (2) is supported by the package.json diff, but a verdict requires BOTH criteria to be substantiated.
